corpus_scope: SAN / BBVA / IBE; IFA-ESEF FY2024-FY2025; IPP Q1/H1/Q3/H2 2024-2026

R1.name: SOURCE_DISCOVERY_EXACT
R1.note: exact corpus enumeration -> artefact proven via listaifi/ListadoIFA for SAN/BBVA/IBE

R2.name: SOURCE_ACCESS_MECHANISM
R2.note: critical finding resolved: use per-entity GET path, bypass general WebForms postback

R4.name: ARTIFACT_URL_STABILITY
R4.note: IPP raw XBRL + ESEF iXBRL byte-stable out-of-session for all three issuers

checkpoint_reason: All four foundations met: reuse viable (R0), discovery reproducible (R3 + enumeration stable), access mechanism stable (R2, per-entity GET), artefacts recoverable reliably (R4 byte-stable out-of-session). GO authorises G1 design, not a full platform.
known_source_risks: IPP ?t={GUID} is ephemeral; canonical identity must use nreg / registro oficial, never ?t={GUID}.
Long-horizon token/URL drift to be monitored in R8.
Issuer-authored filings may carry third-party copyright not covered by CNMV reuse terms.
Entity sitemap is only a partial sample.
legal_constraints: Free private use and faithful reproduction permitted (condition 1).
Paid distribution must inform buyers the data is free at source (condition 2).
No framing; links must open in an independent window (condition 4).
reproducibility_result: IPP raw XBRL and ESEF iXBRL are byte-deterministic out-of-session for SAN, BBVA and IBE (identical SHA-256 across repeated downloads).
